name: WISE 0855-0714
note: Challenge target: a fast-moving brown dwarf (challenge coordinates 08h55m10.831s −07d14m42.53s).
source: NEOWISE-R single-exposure fit with parallax (277 detections 2014–2024, tests/neowise_w0855_plx.py): PM −8.129 ± 0.011, +0.664 ± 0.011 ″/yr, parallax 438 ± 36 mas
photometry: IRSA SPHEREx Source Discovery Tool method on native detector pixels: per-pixel solid-angle map (release-matched, currently cal-sapm-v3-2026-191), r=3 px aperture (photutils subpixel x5), 7-16 px annulus (sigma-clipped median), error from VARIANCE, n_bad = aperture pixels with CONTAINS_BAD_PIXEL flags, counted over every pixel that contributes to the sum; then divided by the ePSF encircled energy
